name: LexAegis: Proof of Review
summary: Proof of Review lets a person approve an exact package of AI-assisted work so anyone can verify it later without trusting the app. LexAegis, employment settlement review for England and Wales, is the reference application.
problem: Advisers increasingly check settlement agreements with AI help, but afterwards nobody can show what exactly was checked, what the figures were and who approved them. Approval lives in a database that the recipient must trust.
solution: An open protocol, SDK, CLI and independent verifier. A person approves a frozen package with a Mera passkey account; a Monad Testnet registry records only a commitment; Envio indexes lifecycle history; Alchemy carries reads and transactions; qwen3.8-max plans the review through read-only tools while code and the human decide. A receipt proves package and account binding, not legal validity or anyone's qualification.
technical: Mera (account layer and separate PRF vault key)
Qwen qwen3.8-max with four read-only tools
TypeScript protocol, SDK, CLI, verifier, embeddable widget
